ropeway:dlg-guide-body: A tower is 22 blocks: the pylon head you already placed, plus 21 more. 1. Two gantries, one level with the pylon head and one three blocks behind it - behind meaning the far side from where you stood when you placed it. Look at the pylon head: while the tower is unfinished the block info panel names the compass direction the rear gantry goes. 2. Each gantry is five ropeway braces wide. The pylon head is the middle brace of the front gantry, so the front gantry needs four more and the rear gantry needs five. 3. Under each of the four outer corners, three blocks of post - logs, debarked logs or planks, any wood you like. That leaves a clear 3 wide, 4 long, 3 tall tunnel for the cabin. Right-click the pylon head to light up every cell that is still wrong: red where the wrong block sits, the wanted block's own colour where nothing does.
